prompt.original: Use `marketplace-liquidity`. We run an on-demand dog walking marketplace in NYC, SF, and LA. Core action: request → booked within 10 minutes. Goal: improve booking fill rate from 55% to 75% in SF evenings within 6 weeks. Baseline: p50 time-to-book is 18 minutes, cancellation rate is 9%. Constraints: $25k/month in incentives, limited eng capacity. Output a Marketplace Liquidity Management Pack.
